I do not buy chemical fertilizer for beans on rented land — that is cash I do not have to spare, and beans grow fine without it anyway. I will plant seed I kept from last year's harvest, and I will spread two cartloads of manure from my animals if there is enough to go around. My children and I will do all the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves on this small plot.
